verdict.rationale: The evidence covers metric collection, custom eval metrics, and threshold alerts on metrics such as Cost and Correctness. None of it documents building custom dashboards or charts over latency, error, cost, or eval-score metrics. Alerting and viewing session-level metrics are adjacent features, not a custom-dashboard capability, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
